decision.rule: pre-registered (cycle 26 P3), every verdict first-class. The seam is judged through the package boundary at the documented Stage 0 budget (72 ticks, the committed comparator grid and covenant), with the instrument required to reproduce the committed switchboard and idle episodes and N5's committed keeper-response floor before anything is judged. G1 the need decays (else withhold); G2 the clean verb clears the committed 0.0685 floor from a dirty live state (else withhold); G3a the dirt->stress consequence moves final stress on the neglect stream by more than zero against the incumbent - the engine is deterministic, so the noise floor is exactly zero - else BLOCKED_ON_MECHANIC, the charter's own refusal; G3b the consequence is bounded - survival and death cause unchanged on the neglect stream and under the autonomous switchboard, and |delta need_balance|/incumbent under the documented D6 welfare bar (5%) - else REFUSE_AS_LETHAL_COSMETIC, and the refusals outrank the withholdings; G4 one clean on a dirty live companion raises cleanliness (else withhold). This module builds no UI.
decision.pre_run_prediction: Written before the run: ADOPT. The neglect stream is expected to show the measurable consequence (dirt pressure raises final stress above the incumbent's committed 0.55004 by a small exact amount) without moving the starvation death at tick 11; the attentive keeper's care is expected to ABSORB the dirt pressure almost entirely (stress relief from feed and sleep dwarfs the <=0.01-per-tick coupling), recorded as the fairness finding either way; the switchboard's welfare impact is expected well under the 5% bar; and the clean verb's +0.32 restore clears the 0.0685 floor by construction - the gate proves the implementation, not the intent. If the measurement disagrees, the measurement wins.

next_research_step: If adopted: land the opt-in readout and the clean verb in the game (same slice), record DR 0059, and name the default-covenant decision as its own future record.
